about: Just Dance 2017 is more fun & easier to play than ever! No camera needed to play. Simply download the free Just Dance Controller App to your smartphone to dance with up to 5 friends!
Just Dance 2017 is coming on October 27th with over 40 tracks at launch, and more than 200 songs available via Just Dance Unlimited! 3-month trial included with your game.
Take a sneak peek at the tracklist below:
• Lean On – Major Lazer Ft. MØ & DJ Snake
• Cheap Thrills – Sia Ft. Sean Paul
• Worth It – Fifth Harmony ft. Kid Ink
summary: Just Dance 2017 is more fun & easier to play than ever! No camera needed to play. Simply download the free Just Dance Controller App to your smartphone to dance with up to 5 friends!
